scripts.native:build:mac: cd native/RocXBridge && cmake -B build -DCMAKE_OSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET=10.15 && cmake --build build --config Release
scripts.native:build:win: cd native/RocXBridge && cmake -B build -G "Visual Studio 17 2022" -A x64 && cmake --build build --config Release
scripts.native:build: node -e "const p=process.platform;if(p==='darwin')require('child_process').execSync('npm run native:build:mac',{stdio:'inherit'});else if(p==='win32')require('child_process').execSync('npm run native:build:win',{stdio:'inherit'});else console.log('skip native build on',p);"
scripts.dev: npm run native:build && cross-env MODE=dev vite build --watch
scripts.build: npm run native:build && cross-env MODE=build vite build
scripts.ccx: npm run native:build && cross-env MODE=package vite build
scripts.zip: npm run native:build && cross-env MODE=zip vite build
